Publish @zamery/browser-firefox@0.2.3 as part of stable v0.2.4 only after the signed Companion tuple is coherent.
Update stable-distribution-acceptance.yml to the v0.2.4 package tuple and signed 0.2.6 XPI URL/hash, then pass it.
Create GitHub stable release v0.2.4 only after signed-browser and clean-distribution gates pass.
